Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting from use taxation motor vehicles used solely in this state for commuting to and from a place of employment located in a contiguous state or foreign country.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a use tax exemption for motor vehiclesused solely in this state for commuting to and from a place ofemployment located in a contiguous state or foreign country; and addinga new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to either an employeror an employee in respect to the use of a motor vehicle owned andproperly registered or licensed by the employer under the laws of acontiguous state or foreign country in which the employer doesbusiness, if the motor vehicle is used in this state solely totransport the employee between an employment location or locations inthat contiguous state or foreign country and the employee's home. Forpurposes of this section, "properly registered" has the same meaning asin RCW 46.85.020.
